body.p: Dengue is the most important mosquito-borne viral disease of humans and is experiencing its largest surge in history1,2. Following a tenfold increase in reported cases over the past two decades, 2024 was the worst year for dengue on record1,2. On 1 December 2023, the World Health Organization (WHO) declared dengue a Grade 3 global health emergency and, in October 2024, launched a cross-departmental global preparedness and response plan1.
